title: Party formations and combo skills
kicker: Delve, siege, party · how the pack stands
loopLine: Dungeon crawler — the Delve · Interactive battles
hook: **Vision:** a second axis besides who is in the pack — **how they stand**, and a few **combination skills**. Not finished / not playable yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Not playable yet. Formations and combo skills are locked design for presence fights.
How the pack stands in a fight you play — not an expedition auto-resolve setting.
A combination skill that depends on who stands with whom — not a second element ring.
Matters in delves and interactive battles. Expeditions stay auto-resolve.

alsoTrue: Named combat reactions / combo recipes are a related Vision on the combat language — different catalog entry.
Who is in the pack is still the first axis — formations do not replace roster choice.

sections.title: Not finished / not playable yet
paras: You will not find a finished formation editor on the live delve or battle stage today — those stages are not in the loop yet.
Expeditions remain auto-resolve and do not need this axis.

sections.title: What it is (design)
paras: Pick who goes. Then pick how they stand.
A short set of combination skills rewards intentional setups when you are playing the fight yourself.
diagram: who is in the pack  +  how they stand  +  combo skills

groups.title: Presence stages
groups.intro: Delves and interactive battles — not idle dispatch.
steps: Provision a pack for a delve or battle.
Set formation when the UI exists.
Use combination skills when the fight opens those windows.
groups.note: Not in the current loop yet.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Keep expeditions auto-resolve — do not expect formation play there.
Treat missing formation UI as Vision, not a bug.
When presence fights ship, learn who + stance + combo as three readable choices.
doNote: Stop when formation ≠ aptitude tree. Parent: [the Delve](delve).

mixUps.q: Is this the same as named reactions?
mixUps.a: Related Vision on combat depth — formations are party stance; named reactions are learnable fight recipes.
No. Not finished / not playable yet.

mixUps.q: Does formation replace who I bring?
mixUps.a: No. It is a second axis beside roster choice.
